name: design-system-documentation-schema
description: A standard, machine-readable format for design system documentation.

scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run build && npm run check:docs
scripts.check: node scripts/bundle.js && node scripts/check-schema-ids.js && node scripts/check-rule-catalog.js && node scripts/sync-examples.js --check && node scripts/validate.js && node scripts/conformance-test.js && node scripts/validate.js test/site-components/index.dsds.yaml test/site-components/components/*.dsds.yaml && node scripts/validate.js examples/interop/color-action-primary.dsds.yaml examples/interop/my-element.dsds.yaml && node scripts/validate.js examples/interop/nested-color.dsds.yaml && node scripts/sync-skill-versions.js --check && npm run generate:check
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-markdown-mirrors.mjs && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-scripts-documented.mjs && stylelint "site/**/*.css"
scripts.generate: node scripts/sync-examples.js && node scripts/bundle.js && node scripts/extract-normative.mjs && node scripts/generate-rule-catalog.mjs && node scripts/generate-examples-index.mjs && node scripts/generate-conformance-suite.mjs
scripts.generate:check: node scripts/extract-normative.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-rule-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-examples-index.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-conformance-suite.mjs --check
scripts.test:a11y: npx playwright install chromium && node scripts/axe-audit.mjs

author: PJ Onori
